mastery_description: Runs unbiased interviews, records past behaviour, kills or confirms a problem with evidence
Can fill and defend a model canvas: segment, value, channel, revenue, costs
Ships a testable MVP in a bounded time/cost and measures use by real users
Applies branch knowledge (EE: power/electronics/embedded; MME: materials/process) to a real product or process
Computes margin, CAC, LTV, burn, runway and break-even from own numbers
Closes first paying pilots; tracks funnel conversion
Knows patent/copyright/trademark/NDA basics, entity choice and institute IP policy
Delivers a 10-slide pitch; knows grants, incubation and equity options
Splits roles and equity in writing; runs weekly sprints with measurable goals
Maps IIT BBS REP, Startup India and Startup Odisha support to the venture stage
